notes.player: The Cult of the Omnissiah preaches that the flesh is inferior to the perfection of the machine, and you have fully internalised that teaching. The number of @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.jsw5d0omkWXaurDM]{Augmetics} you can take is equal to double your Toughness Bonus.

Your knowledge of physiology gives you a keen familiarity with injuries and how they are caused. Though that usually helps you treat them, it also aids your understanding of how to inflict them. When you inflict a Critical Hit or Critical Wound, you may increase its rolled severity by your Advances in the Medicae Skill.

The immaterium lies just behind reality, outside the perception of most creatures in the galaxy, but you are not most creatures. As a psyker, you are aware of the warp, though you may not understand it. You can access and unleash its tumultuous power into realspace.

Channelling such power is fraught with perils, however, and death is far from the most frightening possibility one might face. When you acquire this Talent, you gain the ability to @UUID[JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.T3pf1AmXi3Qnm6ev]{manifest Psychic Powers}. You can also purchase Advances in the @UUID[JournalEntry.J8NVn5iNgM57cKmw.JournalEntryPage.NrJuy93Put0XCYq9#psychic-mastery-(wil)]{Psychic Mastery} Skill and the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.lBzdm76EnuuoGfMq]{Awareness (Psyniscience)} Specialisation.

When you gain this Talent, you learn one @UUID[JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.xoUemA7abdmB6DJ1#minor-psychic-powers]{Minor Psychic Power}. Additionally, select a @UUID[JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.V5zDWussZivkFavj]{Psychic Discipline} and immediately gain one power of your choice from that discipline. You can spend 60 XP to purchase additional Minor Psychic Powers or 100 XP to purchase Psychic Powers from your chosen Discipline.

You can purchase this Talent a number of times up to your Willpower Bonus. Each additional time you purchase this Talent, you access a new Psychic Discipline and one power of that Discipline.

requirement.value: Cannot have the Blank Talent. This applies even during Character Creation

notes.player: Countless hours of practice, training, and drilling have taught you to focus on firing your weapon, even when you are mere inches from danger. An enemy within Immediate range of you does not impose Disadvantage on your Ranged Attacks.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Discipline and Ranged

notes.player:
You are the heir to a lineage of some significance, be that the descendant of a Planetary Governor, the scion of a Rogue Trader Dynasty, the offspring of an influential Gang Leader, or something else entirely (see below). You gain +1 Influence with an appropriate Faction, provided you continue to live up to the legacy of your forebears. If the GM deems it appropriate to your circumstances, you may also be the beneficiary of Inheritance.

Also at the GM’s discretion, this Talent may be taken to reflect more narratively impactful lineages, for your benefit or hinderance. For example, you may be a descendant of one of the vaunted Navis Nobilite, and therefore be able to access the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.RXUhvWSFQ3L4tkqv]{Navigation (Warp)} Specialisation. You may even be a member of one of the xenos-tainted bloodlines of the Genestealer Cults rumoured by some to exist in the sector.

Inheritance

The circumstances of your birth have placed certain burdens on you — an unwelcome duty, perhaps, or familial enemies you have never even met — but it also confers certain benefits. At the GM’s discretion, you may claim an additional 5,000 solars of equipment, holdings, or @UUID[JournalEntry.eUFS6mIQy2oiz6IX.JournalEntryPage.AuM2Lzd784VPe32b#speculation]{investments} when you take this Talent.

requirement.value: Must be taken at character creation

notes.player:
From the multitude of Psykers identified within the Imperium each day, you were marked as having the potential to be more than a sacrifice to fuel the Golden Throne. You have been tested, tormented, and subjected to rites and rituals that you shudder to recall.

The experience was mentally and physically scarring, but it left you more resistant to the dangers of the warp and in control of your power.

Your Warp Threshold is equal to double your Willpower Bonus. You also have a symbol to prove your sanctioned status.

requirement.value: The Psyker Talent. Can only be taken during character creation.

notes.player: Your ally's attacks can open up your enemy's defences, allowing you to better place your shots. When you make a ranged attack targeting an enemy target in the same Zone as one of your revealed allies, your attack can bypass some of their cover. If your target is in Cover they reduce the Armour benefit that Cover grants by 2.

Gothic Gibberish is the appropriately verbose name given to the practice of talking rapidly and incessantly to confound a target by burying them beneath a deluge of obscure information.

You can use Gothic Gibberish by making a Rapport (Charm) Test opposed by the target’s Discipline (Composure). Your target must share at least one language with you, and neither of you can be in combat. If you win the Opposed Test, your target is Stunned for as long as you continue to spout nonsense. Creatures Stunned by your Gothic Gibberish may do nothing other than stare at you dumbfounded as they try to catch up with or understand what you are saying. They may attempt another Discipline (Composure) Test opposed by your Rapport (Charm) at the end of each of their Turns, or whenever the GM deems it fitting — even Gothic Gibberish can’t hold someone’s attention if a firefight breaks out nearby!

Someone spent a great deal of time and effort hypnotically imparting you with specific training you could not consciously recall as it dwelt in your subconscious. Now it has revealed itself to you. Roll twice on the @UUID[RollTable.9SLhM8FOgluaUwvO]{Random Talents} Table. You now have those Talents. Hypno-Indoctrination can only be taken once.

An open mind is like a fortress with its gates unbarred and unguarded, but the gates of your mind are sealed shut. Your mind cannot be read by psychic powers, and you reduce any Damage you would suffer from psychic powers by an amount equal to your Willpower Bonus.

When you lift a holy icon aloft it sends your companions’ hearts soaring. When you are holding a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.oaY0wS7LewD6DXK6]{Holy Icon} any ally within Medium Range that can see you gains the icon's benefit.

requirement.value: 1 Advance in Lore (Theology) and 1 Advance in Presence

notes.player: Those who dare intrude upon your mind find only the punishing lash of your psychic power when you repel their devious attacks. When you win an Opposed Willpower Test to resist a Psychic Power, the psyker manifesting the power suffers Wounds equal to the difference in SL you achieved on the Opposed Test.
Your accumulated years of combat experience allow you to keep lesser fighters at bay. You count as two people for the purposes of determining if one side outnumbers the other in combat.

You have found forbidden ways of preserving the life and limbs of patients you treat, though your radical techniques are far from comfortable. As an Action, you may perform a quick procedure on an ally within Immediate Range. This operation can either turn a Major Break into a Minor Break, or fix a Minor Break instantly. This operation does not remove any Critical Wounds, and actually decreases the target’s maximum Critical Wounds by 1, but they no longer suffer the negative effects of the Major or Minor Break.

You can use both hands equally well, and suffer no penalty for doing something with your ‘off ’ hand. As a result, you may wield a one-handed melee weapon and a pistol at the same time without penalty to attacks with either.

When you open yourself fully to the empyrean, you can channel a flood of its roaring power to amplify your gifts, though such power comes at great risk. When you manifest a psychic power, you can choose to gain a number of Warp Charge up to your Willpower Bonus. If you successfully manifest the power, add +1 SL to the result for each Warp Charge you gained using this Talent.

‘Hate! Hate! Hate! An emotion as pure as it is deep! Hate! Hate! Hate! Let it flow, let it run free!’

— Imperial Hymnal Vol. IV

You wield your fury as a weapon. Choose the object of your hatred — for example, xenos, heretics, or gangers.Whenever you come into contact with the the subject of your hatred, you must make a Difficult (−10) Discipline (Composure) Test. If you fail the Test, you have Advantage on any Discipline (Fear) Tests and +1 SL to any attack Tests you make against the target of your hatred. Whilst overcome by this hate, you must immediately attempt to destroy the hated group by the fastest and most deadly means possible. You may attempt another Difficult (−10) Discipline (Composure) Test at the end of each of your turns to end this effect. Otherwise, the effect ends when you fall unconscious or all visible subjects of your hatred are dead.

You are innately lucky, enjoy the Emperor’s grace, or perhaps have been chosen by the ruinous powers themselves for some great and terrible purpose. Regardless of the reason, you gain 1 point of Fate. You can only take this Talent once.
You aim your weapons carefully in close combat, directing strikes to land where they can do the most harm. You do not have Disadvantage when you take the Target Location Action with a melee weapon.

You have a talent for tailing people without being noticed. When you are attempting to follow a person or group using Navigation (Tracking), you do not need to make Stealth Tests to remain undetected by that individual. This loses effect if attention is drawn to you in some very obvious, or very foolish, way.

Your sense of your body’s spatial movement and location extends to encompass the entirety of a vessel when you are piloting it. For vessels of your chosen Specialisation you always know their size and position in relation to their surroundings, meaning you will always know if the vessel will be able to fit through a gap, or feel if anything is off with the ship, such as a malfunctioning auspex or sabotaged void shield generator. Additionally, you do not suffer Disadvantage from being Blinded when you make a Pilot Test with your chosen Specialisation, and count as two people for the purposes of piloting a vessel that requires multiple crew to operate.

You are particularly talented at a form of honest toil. Select one of the options from the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.GGfP3Qfmx9Zodkol]{Devoted Servant} Table. You gain Advantage on Tests related to your area of expertise.

Devoted Servant Table

Service

Description

Tests

Agronomist

You are talented with farming, fishing, grox herding, or some other method of industrialised sustenance production.

Tests related to food production or the provenance of food, such as identifying where the meat from a noble’s dinner was sourced.

You are a talented cleaner, a master custodian and expert sanitiser.

Tests related to cleaning or janitorial work, such as understanding how a crime scene has been cleansed to remove evidence.

You are a talented performer, practised in an artform of your choice that is designed to keep your superiors and their guests happy.

Tests related to entertaining someone, or attempts to identify another performer’s skills and trainer.

You are a talented hunter, showing proficiency in a self-sustaining lifestyle in uncivilised lands. Choose an environment you are experienced in, such as Forest, Wasteland, or Underhive.

Tests related to setting traps, or identifying animals. You can provide food for a number of people equal to your Perception Bonus when in your chosen environment.

You are a talented clothier, experienced and skilled in making the robes and uniforms that denote status within the Imperium.

Tests related to production of clothing, for example, noticing whether an officer’s uniform is tailored or a hand-me-down, or that a fine outfit was tailored to someone else.

Tests related to the running of a manufactorum, worker shifts, records of outputs, or other relevant matters.

Tests to ascertain the blueprint of a building, attempt to find secret rooms, or take stock of the stability of a construction.

You are talented in preparing often unpalatable raw foodstuffs, making them both nutritious and enjoyable to consume.

Tests to prepare food, such as cooking a meal for your group or attempting to taste food for poison.

Your stoic presence fills the hearts of those around you with bravery even in the face of disadvantage and imminent defeat. Whenever you would lose Superiority, make a Hard (-20) Presence (Leadership) Test. If you succeed, you do not lose Superiority.
You’re strong as a grox, capable of carrying far more crucial gear than even those of similar strength. Your Maximum Encumbrance is equal to double your Strength Bonus, plus your Toughness Bonus.

You know how to take advantage of a dominant situation with precise commands. You can use your Action to give orders to your allies. Choose a number of allies equal to your current Superiority. Each ally can immediately Move or take an Action, other than use the Superior Commander Talent. No character can gain the benefit of this Talent more than once per round.

You are a true believer of the Imperial Cult, a pious and devout member of the state religion of the Imperium and worshipper of the God-Emperor. You are capable of manifesting your faith as a light in the darkness of the 41st Millennium. This power can be used to further His divine will, but if it is misused, the Emperor is sure to punish such treachery.

Once per session you may add your Willpower Bonus in SL when you are making a Test related to your faith. For example:

  • When interrogating a suspected heretic, invoke the God-Emperor’s judgement to gain SL equal to your Willpower Bonus on a Presence (Intimidation) Test.

  • If you are righteously striking down a foul xenos creature or a heretic, you can scream a benediction of the Emperor’s fury to gain SL equal to your Willpower Bonus on your next attack

  • If you are attempting to recall information or locate a particular sacred text, you can make a prayer to the Emperor for guidance to gain SL equal to your Willpower Bonus on your Lore (Theology) Test

requirement.value: You must be a member of the Adeptus Ministorum. If not, you must have +2 Ministorum Influence or 2 Advances in Lore (Theology).

notes.player: You are used to anticipating material needs to complete a mission. Once per mission you can find a piece of equipment you need in your backpack, pockets, or slings. The piece of equipment must be Encumbrance 0 and could feasibly have been acquired recently. This could be anything from a set of Photo-visors you need to explore the crypts beneath a shrine, or a Combi-tool to restore a broken cogitator containing crucial clues. When you use this Talent, you must deduct the cost of the ‘prepared’ equipment from your Solars, representing you spending it earlier.

You’re hard to pin down. When you move out of @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.Rjw4KykpjGJlGYEk#engaged]{Engagement} and an opponent makes an immediate attack against you, they have Disadvantage on that attack Test. If you take this Talent twice you can Disengage as a Free Action.

You are proficient in the art of foul play. When you deal damage with a melee attack, you can choose to inflict the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#blinded]{Blinded} or @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#deafened]{Deafened} Condition. If you succeed by +3 SL or more, you can choose to inflict the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned} Condition instead.

Through accident, proscribed research, or by order of your Patron, you have gained access to unsanctioned information. Each time you take this Talent, you gain access to one of the following Specialisations. You may make Tests related to your chosen Specialisation and purchase Advances in the Specialisation.

  • Linguistics (Forbidden)

  • Lore (Forbidden)

  • Medicae (Forbidden)

requirement.value: Character creation, or with GM permission (see Forbidden Lore)

notes.player: You are a fearsome foe when you wield a weapon with a high rate of fire. If your weapon has the @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#rapid-fire-(rating)]{Rapid Fire} Trait, you can choose to spend double the number of ammunition required for its Rapid Fire Rating. If you do so the weapon's @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#spread]{Spread} Trait affects all creatures within Close Range of the target rather than Immediate Range.

Few pay attention to your existence — you appear without status, beneath notice, another face in the endless crowds of the Imperium.

When you are attired correctly, you can blend into an Imperial environment without making a Test, for example merging with a bustling throng, polishing a statue in a cathedral, or waiting on nobility at an event. Influential people will generally ignore you altogether unless attention is drawn to you. Though this Talent allows you to remain hidden and listen in on conversations it also imposes a Disadvantage on Presence and Rapport Tests targeting such high-status individuals. Additionally, the group does not lose Superiority when you suffer a Critical Wound or die.

requirement.value: No Advances in Presence or any Presence Specialisation, unless acquired through the Random Talents Table.

notes.player: You are a bootlicker, a brown-nose, a grovelling lackey and a sycophantic toady — but that almost always gets you what you want. You gain Advantage on any Test made to suck up to a superior.

You are a Psychic Blank, one of the extremely rare Soulless. Psychic nulls like you carry the Pariah Gene, which denies you a psychic connection to the warp. Without that link, you have no presence within the immaterium, rendering you anathema to nearby psykers and daemons. You curtail access to the immaterium in your immediate area. Ordinary Humans find your presence disturbing, and may even suffer headaches or nausea from prolonged exposure to you.

This Talent includes the following effects:

  • You automatically win any Opposed Test to resist a Psychic Power. Your result is always a Success (+1 SL).

  • You cannot be detected through @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.lBzdm76EnuuoGfMq]{Psyniscience} alone.

  • You are immune to Daemonic Possession.

  • You never gain @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.PuzopCeKzYgcYAwh]{Corruption Points}.

  • You make Fellowship Tests when interacting with any creature with a connection to the warp with Disadvantage (i.e. all non-Blank Humans).

  • Tests made to Manifest a psychic power that targets your Zone, an individual in your Zone, or made within @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#range-and-movement]{Short Range} of you suffer from Disadvantage.

  • Daemons treat the Zone you are in as a @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Minor Hazard}.

  • Individuals connected to a psychic hive mind (such as Genestealer Cultists) that enter or start their turn in your Zone must make a Challenging (+0) Discipline (Composure) or be @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned (Minor)}.

requirement.value: Can only be taken during Character Creation. You can never be a Psyker and a Blank.

scriptData.label: Manifesting Psychic Power near a Blank
Interacting with those who have connection to the warp.

notes.player: You are capable of impressive bursts of speed when your life is on the line. If you have a @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.UaRHLqZ99zmg7AeE#critical-wounds]{Critical Wound} your Speed increases by one step until the end of the Encounter, and you have Advantage on Athletics Tests made during a @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#pursuit]{Pursuit} or while @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#flee]{Fleeing}.

scriptData.label: Athletics during Pursuit or while Fleeing

notes.player: You are quick enough to interpose yourself between your allies and harm. As a @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.YEIzXenjBxa3GlTQ#free-actions]{Free Action} at the start of combat, choose one allied character within Medium Range. You are their guardian and are considered to be defending them for the duration of the combat. If the target is attacked and you are within Medium Range, you can immediately move to @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#defend]{Defend} them. If doing so causes you to break @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.Rjw4KykpjGJlGYEk#engaged]{Engagement}, your opponents have Disadvantage on their melee attack.

You can perform phlebotomies and bloodletting, and are capable of examining an individual’s blood to learn about their health. When you make a successful melee attack you can choose to inflict the Bleeding Condition instead of dealing Damage.

You are so familiar with the particular environs of your upbringing that you can better find cover to protect yourself or disappear entirely. Choose an environment from the following list. Within that environment you have Advantage on Stealth Tests and gain +1 Armour from @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#cover]{Cover} in addition to what that cover typically grants. You may take this Talent multiple times, choosing another type of terrain each time.

  • Agri: Farmed fields, slaughterhouses, and other locations dedicated to food or water production.

  • Feudal: Any Human civilisation that is not a hive city, on a Forge world, or on a Shrine World.

  • Forge: Manufactorums, Omnissian forge-shrines, and the streets of Forge Worlds.

  • Hive: Anywhere in a hive city, including the toxic sumps that often lie beneath.

  • Natural: Forests, mountains, grasslands, plains, and other natural biomes untouched by civilisation.

  • Shrine: Churches, cathedrals, tombs, and the streets of Shrine Worlds.

  • War zone: Any location that is or was recently an active war zone, as well as military buildings and active encampments.

  • Wasteland: The irradiated wastelands beyond hive cities, tundras, deserts.

  • Voidship: Any void-faring vessel of Imperial design.

You are either a licensed member of a chartist captain’s crew within the Merchant Fleet, a black market trader operating outside it, or are simply confident enough to pass yourself off as one of these. The base cost when you @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.k5sND1C17nY9xB1G#selling]{sell an item} is increased from 50% (rounded up) to 100%. Representatives of the Administratum or local infractionists may visit you @UUID[JournalEntry.eUFS6mIQy2oiz6IX]{Between Missions} to request a tithe to allow you to trade in such a way.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in Logic (Evaluation) and 2 Advances in Rapport (Haggle)

notes.player: It's tough to keep you down. Whenever you suffer the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned} Condition, you may immediately make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Endurance) to recover from the Condition.

Explosives are your area of expertise, and you’ve proved yourself able to use them successfully without blowing yourself up. Over the course of an hour, you can make a Challenging (+0) Tech (Engineering) to remove the @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#unstable]{Unstable} Trait from an explosive. The GM determines the Difficulty. Additionally, when preparing @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.Slqoyw0d5t8b9amF#delayed-explosions]{delayed explosives} you may increase the Damage of those explosives by your Intelligence Bonus.

This Talent can be taken an additional time. If you do, each time you make an attack with a weapon with the Blast Trait you can aim it in such a way that it ignores one character it would otherwise damage or effect.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in Ranged (Ordnance) or 2 Advances in Dexterity (Defuse)

notes.player:
Simply denying a psyker access to the warp isn’t enough for you. You twist their power, redirecting it to sear their mind, punishing them for their sorcerous transgressions and unforgivable blasphemies.

When you successfully use @UUID[JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.T3pf1AmXi3Qnm6ev#deny-the-witch!]{Deny the Witch} to prevent a psyker from manifesting a psychic power, that psyker suffers Wounds equal to the Warp Rating of the power they attempted to manifest.

You move in a calculated manner ensuring you can get into a safe position quickly. You can @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#take-cover]{Take Cover} as a @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.YEIzXenjBxa3GlTQ#free-actions]{Free Action}.

requirement.value: 1 Advance in both Athletics and Discipline

notes.player: The way you speak is unsettling, and to some, frightening. You gain +2 SL to Presence (Interrogation) and (Intimidation) Tests when using your voice. You suffer a −2 SL penalty to Fellowship Tests against someone that is disturbed by your voice, as determined by the GM.

You can recall things you’ve seen with incredible clarity and fidelity for much longer than most people. Once you see something, even briefly, you can recall an image of what you saw with virtually perfect accuracy. You do not need to make Tests to recall visual details about images you saw.

You are capable of forging documentation that allows you to wield Influence over a specific Faction. The Faction you are trying to gain Influence over determines the type of Test you must make when attempting to create the forgery, which takes a full day. Some example factions are listed below, though the GM may allow other options.

  • Adeptus Administratum: Lore (Adeptus Terra)

  • Adeptus Ministorum: Lore (Theology)

  • The Inquisition: Linguistics (Cipher)

  • Rogue Trader Dynasty: Linguistics (High Gothic)

The difficulty of the Test determines how much Influence the forgery will give you:

  • Difficult (−10): +1 Influence

  • Hard (−20): +2 Influence

  • Very Hard (−30): +3 Influence

When you make the Test to forge the document, keep track of your SL. Anyone who inspects the document to discern its veracity makes an Opposed Test of their Logic (Evaluation) against the SL of your original Test.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Linguistics and Lore

notes.player: You have learned to wield two melee weapons at once. You do not suffer Disadvantage when attacking with two melee weapons at the same time. See @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.Rjw4KykpjGJlGYEk#two-weapon-fighting]{Two-weapon Fighting} for more information.

Breaking and entering comes naturally to you. You have Advantage on Tests related to breaking and entering a location, such as climbing the exterior of a building, quietly breaking windows, or unlocking doors or lockboxes.

requirement.value: 1 Advance in both Athletics and Stealth

notes.player: One of your primary five senses is highly developed, allowing you to spot what others miss. You may make Perception Tests to detect normally imperceptible details with the associated sense, as dictated by the GM. This could include seeing a lone Servo-Skull at an incredible distance, detecting the presence of a near-odourless poison, hearing the breath of a motionless ganger hidden in the next room, reading printed text by touch, or knowing by taste alone that two ration packages come from different manufactorums.

You have a natural talent for the arts. This Talent can be taken multiple times, each time choose one of the following:

  • Literature: +2 SL to any Test related to reading or writing, such as cataloguing a comprehensive and persuasive evidential case or recognizing which Imperial sagas are being referenced in an ingeniously coded message.

  • Painting: +2 SL to any Test related to painting or drawing, such as creating a sketch of a person of interest or identifying the artist of an Imperial fresco and that it is a forgery.

  • Music: +2 to any Test related to singing or performing music, such as leading a religious chorus or surmising which planet in a particular sub-sector someone is from based on the tunes they hum.

  • Theatre: +2 SL to any Test related to acting or performing, such as dramatically depicting a character or identifying whether someone is wearing a uniform that was not made for them.

Any Test related to painting or drawing
Any Test related to acting or performing
Any Test related to singing or performing music

notes.player: You are able to disarm an opponent with a careful flick of the wrist or a well-aimed blow to the hand. When you make a melee attack against an opponent who is the same size or smaller than you, instead of dealing damage you can choose to disarm them. If you succeed, your opponent drops a held object, which flies into a random adjacent Zone (with further effects as determined by the GM). If you win by +2 SL, you can determine which Zone the object lands in; if you win by +4 SL, you can take the object if you have a free hand, plucking it from the air with a flourish.
Those who strike first strike hardest. You may take 2 Actions on your turn during a Surprise Round.
You know how to deliver a crushing final blow when you are dominating a situation. If you have 2 or more Superiority, you can take 2 turns in a row, sacrificing your turn next round.

Conforming to the idiom that 'the best defence is offence', you respond to an incoming attack with a lightning-fast counterstrike of your own.

If you are the target of a melee attack and win the @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.Rjw4KykpjGJlGYEk#melee-attack]{Opposed Melee Test}, you can choose to deal Damage to your opponent as if you made the attack.

You may purchase this Talent multiple times. You may Counter Attack once per round for each time you have purchased this Talent.

You can reload some weapons faster than most. This Talent can be taken multiple times. Each time choose a ranged Specialisation. You can reload weapons relating to those Specialisations as a Free Action.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Dexterity and Ranged

notes.player:
You are an experienced Void Traveller and are all but immune to any void-sickness due to the shifting of a vessel. You do not suffer Disadvantage due to environmental effects specific to the void, such as a ship rocking or zero gravity.

You can take this Talent multiple times. Each time after the first choose one:

  • Attitude Control: You have mastered movement in the void, capable of quickly pushing yourself from surface to surface. You are Fast when moving in zero-gravity environments.

  • Void Brawler: You have experience fighting in the void. You have Advantage when making Melee Attacks in zero-gravity environments against characters who do not have the Void Legs Talent.

scriptData.label: Advantage with melee attacks in zero-gravity against those who do not have Void Legs

notes.player: When you strike an enemy, you can take advantage of their pain to acrobatically reposition yourself. As a Free Action, when you deal one or more Wounds or Critical Wounds, you can make a Reflexes (Acrobatics) Test to Disengage and move to an adjacent Zone.

You can use a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.qjjlckQ3WvF4KLxO]{Chirurgeon's Kit} to perform surgery. You can perform @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.UaRHLqZ99zmg7AeE#amputations]{Amputations} and treat Critical Wounds that are beyond the skills of others. Additionally you gain Advantage when treating Critical Wounds in combat.

You can bend and twist your body to escape restraints and squeeze into smaller places. You are capable of fitting into unusually small or cramped spaces, such as the narrow pipes of a manufactorum. Additionally you have Advantage on Tests to resist or end the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#restrained]{Restrained} Condition or a grapple.

Your dedication to your faith is such that you have shed many of the concerns of your flesh. You are happy to endure as much pain as required in service to the Emperor, and may even come to see that suffering as a form of worship far more holy than even the most sweetly sung hymn or devout prayer.

You gain Advantage on any Test to resist the effects of pain or interrogation. Additionally, any time you suffer a Critical Wound you may make a Challenging (+0) Lore (Theology). If you succeed, you may ignore the effects of that Critical Wound for a number of rounds equal to your Willpower Bonus. During this time your faith sustains your mortified flesh, allowing you to fight on where most others would have fallen. Once the duration of this effect is over, you suffer the full effects of the Critical Wound as normal.

scriptData.label: Resisting effects of pain and interrogation

notes.player: You are proficient in using a shield to deflect danger from multiple sources. When using a shield and taking the Defend Action, you may choose to Defend an additional ally that is within Immediate Range, or choose to Defend both an ally within Immediate Range and the Zone you currently occupy.

You’ve learned how to unleash a hail of fire to pin down your enemies. When you @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#rapid-fire-(rating)]{Rapid Fire} you can choose to deal no damage and attempt to suppress them instead. Your target and anyone within immediate range of them must make a Discipline (Fear) Test opposed by your Ranged Test. If you win, you inflict the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#restrained]{Restrained} Condition on your targets until the start of your next turn.

You’re practiced in instructing others to work just as well as yourself. As an Action, you may make a Challenging (+0) (Leadership) to aid an ally or subordinate. If you succeed, your target may use your Skill instead of their own for the next Test they make.

Due to physiology-altering surgeries, inborn talent, or vocal training, you have the remarkable ability to mimic another person’s speech patterns and voice. You can mimic a person’s voice after you listen to them speak for at least one hour. This Talent does not allow you to speak a language you don’t know.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Awareness (Hearing) and Rapport (Deception)

notes.player:
Regardless of your usual personality, you know how to be particularly vexing by interrupting people with disruptive, irritating, or offensive outbursts that are extremely effective distractions.

You can use this Talent once per encounter to interrupt another individual making a Test, imposing Disadvantage on their Test. In combat, this Talent is used as a @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.YEIzXenjBxa3GlTQ#reactions]{Reaction}.

If you purchase this Talent again, you can choose to gain one of the following:

  • Centre of Attention: When you are within Immediate range of an individual that isn’t your ally, you may choose to inflict Disadvantage on Tests that target makes with anyone other than you.

  • Stunning Interjection: Once per encounter when you use the Distraction Talent, your target is Stunned (Minor) until the end of their next Turn.

You’re a fantastic fencer when engaging an opponent one-on-one in armed melee combat. You treat all One-handed melee weapons that do not have the Subtle Trait as having Defensive Trait.

This Talent can be taken multiple times, each time after the first, choose to gain one of the following:

  • Duellist Feint: When you successfully attack with a One-handed melee weapon, you can choose to deal no damage and instead impose Disadvantage on attacks the target makes against you until the end of your next Turn.

  • Duellist Guard: When you make an attack with a One-handed melee weapon, you can choose to make that attack with Disadvantage to simultaneously make the Dodge Action.
You have Advantage when performing autopsies to determine the cause and nature of someone’s death, and analyse any medical imbalances in their system.

You maintain a secret identity that allows you to appear to be a member of another Faction. With your GM’s permission, choose a @UUID[JournalEntry.uJURMn2glWHhjqJk.JournalEntryPage.ZJ4j0hrbxg7bL2K4]{Faction} and a matching Duty, or another reasonable duty in the Imperium. As long as you are dressed and behaving appropriately, you have +1 Influence with that Faction. Maintaining this masquerade requires Rapport (Deception) Tests when interacting with certain members of that faction.

You can work yourself into a frothing battle rage. As a Free Action you can make a Challenging (+0) Willpower to enter a frenzied state. While frenzied your Strength Bonus increases by +1 and you are immune to the Frightened Condition. On your turn, you must attempt to engage the nearest enemy in melee combat. You remain in this state until all enemies you can currently see have been defeated, or until you are affected by the Stunned or Unconscious Condition.

This Talent can be taken multiple times, each time choose one of the following:

  • Frenzied Control: You can make a Difficult (−10) Discipline (Composure) Test as an Action, to halt your Frenzied state.

  • Frenzied Fearlessness: Whenever you would become Frightened, you may immediately become Frenzied instead.

  • Frenzied Momentum: One per Turn, when you kill an enemy whilst Frenzied, you may immediately Move or take another Action.

scriptData.label: Roll Test

notes.player:
Your senses are permanently engaged in a hunt for the enemies of the Emperor, to the extent that you sleep with one eye open. You gain +1 SL to Tests to detect hidden enemies, and you suffer no penalties from the Unconscious or Blinded Conditions while sleeping.

Additionally, whenever you leave a location that has an object of interest or clue that the group did not find or closely examine, the GM may make a secret Awareness Test on your behalf with a Difficulty they determine. If the Test is successful, the GM may reveal this clue to you.

You are skilled in trading and know how to close a deal. During a negotiation you can make an Intuition (People) Test. If you succeed you gain the benefit of one of the following effects:

  • You learn what the target would accept as a bribe, be it an object, specific information, or an amount of Solars. Not everyone can be bribed.

  • You decrease the cost of anything you buy from the target by 10%.

  • You increase the cost of anything you sell to the target by 10%.

requirement.value: 1 Advance in both Intuition (People) and Rapport (Haggle)

notes.player: You are unafraid to die in the God-Emperor’s name. If you have at least one untreated Critical Wound received in the Emperor's service, you gain +SL to Tests equal to your Willpower Bonus. Only Tests made to directly confront your foes may benefit from this bonus.

scriptData.label: Confronting foes, has untreated Critical Wounds

notes.player:
Your medical training allows you to find faults in anatomy and exploit them with ease. As an Action, you can break the bone of a Restrained target that you have the relevant Medicae Specialisation for. Select a Hit Location. That Hit Location now has a @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.UaRHLqZ99zmg7AeE#broken-bones]{Broken Bone (Minor)}. If the Hit Location already has a Broken Bone (Minor), it now has a Broken Bone (Major).

Example

Klaudia has 2 Advances in Medicae (Aeldari) and is @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#grapple]{Grappling} an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.actors.Actor.xHzo06YI2vDu4kM0]{Aeldari Ranger}. As an Action, she uses Bone Breaker on the Restrained Aeldari Ranger and targets their Arm. The Aeldari Ranger now has a Broken Bone (Minor) on that limb, inflicting Disadvantage on any actions that use it.
Speed and accuracy make your attacks more potent than powerful blows. You may use your Agility Bonus instead of your Strength Bonus when calculating damage for melee weapons with the Subtle Trait.

You are a dutiful assistant, rendering aid with efficiency and aplomb even when the activity would normally be outside your skillset. You can use the @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#help]{Help} Action to assist someone even if you do not have Advances in the Skill being Tested. Additionally, if you do have an Advance, they gain +1 SL on the Test.

You’ve trained yourself to ensure you always shoot first. When combat begins, you can draw and fire a Pistol before anyone else, regardless of Initiative order. If you are Surprised, you must make a Hard (−20) Reflexes Test to use this effect.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Ranged (Pistols) and Reflexes

notes.player: You have a natural instinct for who can be paid off, and how to manipulate them with an appropriate ‘donation’ of Solars. You have Advantage on all Intuition (People) Tests to gauge whether someone would be amenable to a bribe. Additionally, you decrease the cost of any bribe by 10% for every Advance in Rapport (Haggle) you have.

There typically isn’t time to properly treat wounds during a crisis, but a savvy healer like yourself knows how to patch up wounds and render immediate first aid to save lives under pressure. When you make a Medicae Test to @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.6xiBUWxGfkcy3Fe2]{heal} a character, the Difficulty can not be harder than Challenging (+0).

You’ve practised analysing the physicality of speech, recognizing the sounds people make by visual observation alone. Even if you can’t hear someone talk, you can understand what they're saying by reading their lips.

requirement.value: 1 Advance in both Awareness (Sight) and Linguistics

notes.player:
You’ve been trained to face down the innumerable dangers of the universe, especially if you are backed up by other trained warriors. You have Advantage on Tests to resist the Frightened Condition, and you gain +1 SL to Discipline Tests for every ally with the Drilled Talent in the same Zone as you.

If another member of your group has the Drilled Talent, you can both choose to purchase the Drilled Talent again to gain the following:

  • Kill Team: When you are in the same Zone as another member of your party with the Drilled Talent, you can choose to act immediately after them in Initiative and gain +1 SL to all Tests.

effectDocs.name: Kill Team
effectDocs.description: Activate this effect when using the Kill Team option.

notes.player:
You are naturally in tune with the flow of data and recorded information, effortlessly able to navigate the often byzantine records of the Imperium. You have Advantage on Tests made to find or retrieve information from a document or archive (whether analog or digital). Additionally, you read text in half the time it would normally take.

If you take this Talent again, you have Advantage on any Test made to determine where, when, how, or by whom a piece of information was created.

scriptData.label: Retrieving information from documents or archives
Determining where, when, how, or by whom a piece of information was created

notes.player: You are ruthless in your use of information on your opponents. If you spend time to @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.3j1kargHBeCTssE7#know-thy-foe]{Know Thy Foe} before combat, you may choose the Hit Location of your first successful attack.
Your presence fills your allies with zeal. Allies in your Zone that can see you gain Advantage on Discipline Tests.

You exude confidence and command, your mere presence influential to many. The first time you meet a group, you can make a Challenging (+0) Presence or Rapport. On a success, you gain +1 Influence with that group until the end of the mission.

The Imperial Cult preaches that ignorance is the best defence against the horrors of heretical thought. You are particularly ignorant, warding you from the predations of the daemons of the warp. You gain +4 SL on all Tests made to resist @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.PuzopCeKzYgcYAwh]{Corruption}, psychic powers, and the influence of daemonic forces. However, you also suffer a penalty of −4 SL on all Tests related to researching, tracking, or recalling information about daemons, psykers, and xenos.

requirement.value: Less than 30 Intelligence, cannot have Advances in any (Forbidden) Specialisation

scriptData.label: Resisting Corruption, psychic powers, and the influence of daemonic forces
Researching, tracking, or recalling information about daemons, psykers, and xenos.

notes.player: You know how to use the confusion of battle to reposition yourself by feigning cowardice. As an Action, you can pretend to @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#flee]{Flee}. Reduce Superiority by 1 and remove yourself from the encounter. At the start of your next turn, you can choose any location within Long Range of your previous location. You are now in that location and hidden from your enemies. When — or indeed, if — you return to the Encounter, Superiority increases by 1.

You’ve practised wide swings with formidably large weapons, intent on clearing entire swathes of enemies with each broad stroke. When you wield a melee weapon with the @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#two-handed]{Two-handed} Trait, it also gains the @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#spread]{Spread} Trait. Attacks you make with such a weapon do not strike you.

This Talent can be taken multiple times. On the second and third time, choose one of the following:

  • Two-handed Brutalist: When you wield a weapon with the Two-handed Trait, it also gains the @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#rend-(rating)]{Rend (+1)} Trait.

  • Two-handed Sweep: When you wield a weapon with the Two-handed Trait and hit a target in the leg you can choose to half the Damage dealt to force the target to make a Hard (−20) Reflexes (Balance) Test or fall Prone.

You are an expert at hiding small objects about your person — perhaps in a small compartment hidden in your clothing, or even in a hollow chamber inside an augmetic limb.

You can conceal one small item, no bigger than the palm of your hand. Anyone searching you must make a Hard (−20) Awareness (Touch), Dexterity (Pickpocket) or Logic (Investigation) Test to discover the hidden object. If the individual searching you employs any technology, such as an @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.dO7XoDXD9QYTy6zZ]{Auspex} or a Cyber-hound, this difficulty is reduced to Challenging (+0).

You have learned to wield two ranged weapons at once. You do not suffer Disadvantage when attacking with two ranged weapons at the same time. See @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.Rjw4KykpjGJlGYEk#two-weapon-fighting]{Two-weapon Fighting} for more information.

The Lex Imperialis is composed of myriad inscrutable laws that keep the Imperium aloft, and you know how to wield them like a weapon — or at least have the confidence to threaten others with their execution. When you make a Rapport or Presence Test and know the target of your Test has broken some kind of law, you can reference that law to gain +SL to the Test equal to your Advances in Lore (Adeptus Terra).

You find humour in the darkest of places, and can use it to bolster the morale of your allies, keeping them alive in the direst of times. As an Action, you can use Charm (Rapport) to make a joke that can stabilise someone in a dire situation.

  • If your target is Fatigued or Frightened, you can make a Challenging (+0) Rapport (Charm) as an Action to remove the Condition.

  • If your target is Stunned, you can make a Challenging (+0) Rapport (Charm) as an Action to remove the Condition.

  • If your target is Dying, you can make a Challenging (+0) Rapport (Charm). If you succeed, your target does not die at the end of the round, and instead can survive for another 1 + SL rounds.

When you take the time to line up a shot in a practised manner, the benefits of your training flourish.

When you @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#aim]{Aim} and make a Ranged Attack you gain +1 SL. If you purchase this Talent again, when you Aim you have Advantage on Tests to Target a Location.

You’re steady on your feet. If you have at least one point of Superiority you become Fast.

Additionally, you have Advantage on Tests to resist or end the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#prone]{Prone} Condition, you can stand up from Prone as a Free Action once per Turn if you are not Restrained, and you have Advantage on Tests to resist being moved from your position against your will.

requirement.value: 1 Advance in each of Athletics, Fortitude, and Reflexes

scriptData.label: Resisting Prone or being moved against your will

notes.player: The Familiar is extremely resilient, pulling through even when dangerously wounded. This Talent can be taken multiple times, but no more than the Familiar’s Toughness Bonus (TghB). The Familiar ignores the first number of Critical Wounds equal to the number of times they have this Talent.

Armour plating is attached to the Familiar, implanted subdermally or bolted onto mechanical frames. A Familiar with this Talent gains +1 Armour. This Talent may be purchased a number of times equal to the Familiar’s Strength Bonus, but each purchase after the first weighs them down, inflicting a cumulative -5 to Agility.

requirement.value: Spend 500 Solars each time the Talent is taken.

notes.player: The Familiar has an uncanny knack for identifying a specific character trait in others. When purchasing this Talent, choose a descriptive trait (e.g. untrustworthy, wealthy, drug user, etc.). When in the presence of a person who shares that trait, the Familiar communicates this fact subtly to its master, such as a soft growl and unusual mechanical noise, gripping tighter to their shoulder or some other minor display

You know or may have been mentored, that following your instincts can often lead to clues or connections that might otherwise go overlooked. When conducting an investigation or research, you can spend 1 Fate Point to gain a personal hint from the GM about where to go next, what to do, how clues might be connected, or who to talk to. This takes the form of a hunch and guides you toward new information at the GM’s discretion.

Following the Amalathian philosophy of the Inquisition, you believe that the Imperium is strongest when all its elements work together. Rather than bully or use authority to force compliance, you are adept at coercing and manoeuvring the Imperium into cooperation. At the end of any positive interaction with the representative of another Imperial Faction, you can spend a Fate point to make a Rapport Test, the Difficulty determined by the GM. On a success, that representative becomes a Contact.

This Talent can be taken multiple times. Each time after the first, choose one of the following:

  • Coercive Favour: When you seek to use Inquisitorial Requisitions, you gain +1 SL on a Rapport Test made to find who can aid you in this manner, and you gain +1 SL on a Rapport Test when requisitioning the aid.

  • Cooperative Spirit: Once per mission, when you would lose Influence with a faithful Faction of the Imperium, you can attempt a Rapport Test to smooth over issues and prevent that loss. The GM determines how complicated the issue is and adjusts the Difficulty accordingly. On a success, the amount of Influence lost with the faithful Faction is reduced by 1, to a minimum loss of 1.

  • Suppression Orders: You gain +1 SL on any Tests made to enlist the aid of, or convince, local authorities to suppress information, block communications, and shut down any investigations that might implicate or reveal the identities of you and your fellow acolytes.

A Psyker struggling to control their powers may redirect excess warp energies through their Psyber-Familiar. The Psyber-Familiar grants Advantage on @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.buydA5mPJln97Qk5#purgation]{Purgation} Tests to their Master. This Talent can be purchased an additional time, extending Advantage to rolls on the Psychic Phenomena Table before adding Warp Charge to the result. The Psyber-Familiar suffers 1 Wound per Warp Charge dissipated in this way.

Channelling psychic ripostes through a Psyber-Familiar lends their Master a measure of the creature’s own abilities. Whenever the Psyker wins an Opposed Willpower Test to resist a Psychic Power, instead of inflicting Wounds, they may choose to inflict a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe]{Condition} that their Familiar’s attacks or abilities could inflict.

requirement.value: The Familiar’s Master must have the Psychic Castigation Talent.

notes.player:
Under the tutelage of an Inquisition-approved psyker, administering you with an intense and dangerous training regimen, the range of your anti-psyker capabilities has been improved. You can now deny their manifestations with greater strength and from a greater range.

You have Advantage whenever you challenge psykers with @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.T3pf1AmXi3Qnm6ev#deny-the-witch!]{Deny the Witch!}. This Talent can be taken multiple times. The second time, the range of your Deny the Witch! increases to Medium Range instead of Short Range. The third time, the range increases to Long Range.

requirement.value: Willpower 40, the Psyker Talent or Condemn the Witch Talent
requirement.script: return this.actor.system.characteristics.wil.total >= 40 || this.actor.itemTypes["talent"].find(i => i.name == "Psyker") || this.actor.itemTypes["talent"].find(i => i.name == "Condemn The Witch")

notes.player: In the Warp, distance is meaningless compared to the symbolic bonds between two souls. Psykers with a bound Familiar use this bond to extend their powers through their Familiar. When casting a psychic power, the Familiar’s Master may cast it where their Familiar counts as the power’s point of origin. Beyond Long Range, the Difficulty of the Power’s Psychic Mastery Test increases; −10 within the limits of a hive city, −20 within the scope of a continent, and so on.

The Psyber-Familiar’s Master may direct it to actively purge the energies that build up from the use of psychic powers. At the end of each Turn, the Psyber-Familiar’s Master loses 1 Warp Charge. Warp Charge from sustained powers cannot be removed while the power is active.

You have training in covering your tracks, minimising the evidence of your passage through violent and nonviolent encounters. When you leave an encounter, you can negate the loss of any @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.KbejcPMug5gfoWWz.JournalEntryPage.XyTxLhjDZDkpE0Lz]{Subtlety} you might have contributed to. The Test required depends on the situation, and the GM may ask for any of the following:

  • Logic (Investigation) to remove physical evidence of your passage or to disguise a violent encounter as something less suspicious, such as simple ganger violence.

  • Stealth to move in and out of the scene without attracting attention from bystanders or casual observers, making it less likely, or simply slower, for rumours to spread.

  • Tech (Security) to sabotage or wipe devices such as pict-recorders, making it harder to identify you, but not entirely erasing suspicion.

Any Logic or Tech Test would take at least 10 minutes to complete.

requirement.value: 2 Advances across any of the following — Logic (Investigation), Stealth, or Tech (Security).
requirement.script: return this.actor.system.skills.stealth.advances +  (this.actor.itemTypes.specialisation.find(i => i.name == "Tech" && i.system.skill == "security")?.system?.advances || 0) + (this.actor.itemTypes.specialisation.find(i => i.name == "Investigation" && i.system.skill == "logic")?.system?.advances || 0) >= 2

notes.player: Stealth and deception have become second nature to you through rigorous training and the dangers of past experiences. You ignore the Disadvantage penalty to Stealth Tests due to your current @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.KbejcPMug5gfoWWz.JournalEntryPage.XyTxLhjDZDkpE0Lz]{Subtlety}.

The Psyber-Familiar’s Master may wield its insignificant soul like a shield against the Immaterium. If its Master must roll on the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.buydA5mPJln97Qk5#perils-of-the-warp]{Perils of the Warp} Table, the Psyber-Familiar may be designated as the target of the results instead.

You have an approved, or self-taught, swathe of technical skills related to security systems and their associated machine spirits. You have Advantage on all Tests to identify security systems, such as what they are and what they are capable of, as well as any Tests made to interact with those systems, to sabotage them, bypass them, or access them to learn more information.

This Talent can be taken multiple times.

The second time you gain the following: When leaving any security system or control system you accessed, you can attempt to make a Tech (Security) Test to erase evidence of your actions, such as clearing access logs and clearance codes. The GM will determine how difficult the Test is, and a success could make it difficult to notice the system was breached, as well as minimise any evidence left behind for the purposes of affecting @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.KbejcPMug5gfoWWz.JournalEntryPage.XyTxLhjDZDkpE0Lz]{Subtlety}.

Through experience and dedicated training, you can identify weapons used at a scene by the marks, bullet hole shape, casings, and shrapnel left behind. When you investigate a scene and use Logic (Investigation), in addition to whatever information you would normally glean, you may also learn details of the ranged weapons used in any confrontation and what manner of ammunition was expended at the scene. A result with particularly high SL may indicate how trained or proficient the marksmen at the scene were.

requirement.value: 1 Advance in both Logic (Investigation) and Ranged.

notes.player:
You have been the vessel for a daemon, willingly or otherwise, and have survived a harrowing exorcism. The experience has left you mentally scarred, plagued with nightmares, and your hollowed soul numbs you to the world around you. Someone within the Inquisition has deemed you of use, but you will never again be the same, and any who discover you once served as a vessel for such an entity will attempt to kill you on the spot.

  • You have −1 SL on all Fellowship Tests; the hollowing of your soul from the absence of the daemon leaves you detached.

  • You are immune to the mutating effects of Corruption.

  • You have +1 SL on any Awareness Test to detect the presence of daemonic entities or any phenomena associated with daemons.

  • You are immune to being possessed again by the same specific daemonic entity

requirement.value: Can only be taken during Character Creation or at GM's discretion. You cannot be a Blank.

notes.player:
You have the knowledge and training to acquire a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.UHAAGHOTknUiUTUj]{Familiar}. The first time you purchase this Talent, you can bond with a Regular Familiar, though they still need to be found and purchased.

This Talent can be taken more than once.

The second time you take this Talent, you can choose to become trained in Cyber- or PsyberFamiliars, and the third time you take this Talent, you become trained in bonding with the remaining type of Familiar.

You can acquire any Familiar with which you are trained via this Talent and any Familiar that might be a combination, so long as you have all of the prerequisites of that combination.

You have developed remarkable proficiency in identifying codes, cyphers, and other symbols laden with meaning through comprehensive study and thorough testing. Some cults use obscure symbols to denote their members, some might mark buildings and locations within a hive with hidden signs, and others disguise their communications using a secret code. You have Advantage on Tests to recognise or decipher symbols, marks, and secret codes.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Linguistics (Cipher) and Logic.

scriptData.label: Advantage to recognize/decipher symbols, marks, and secret codes

notes.player: The Familiar is so attuned to the needs of its Master that it responds almost before a command is issued. When @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.EwKNNdQ5EYayCPdA#getting-help]{Helping} their Master with a Test, the Familiar also counts as an extra source of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.EwKNNdQ5EYayCPdA#advantage-and-disadvantage]{Advantage}.

The Psyber-Familiar is trained to aid its master when disrupting another Psyker’s powers. The Familiar grants its Master a +10 bonus to all attempts to @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.T3pf1AmXi3Qnm6ev#deny-the-witch!]{Deny the Witch!}.

Through a combination of hypno-indoctrination and specialised training, you are prepared to infiltrate various cults and organisations at the behest of the Inquisition.

This Talent can be taken multiple times. Each time, choose one of the following disguises, but you also gain 2 Corruption Points.

  • Heretek: You have adopted a disguise including a prosthetic augmetic that passes as genuine only until inspected up close by a member of the Cult Mechanicus or someone equally knowledgeable. You have meme-coded technical secrets into your mind, granting you +2 SL on Tech Tests.

  • Aristocrat: Psycho-linguistic and memetic routines have trained you to recall names and interconnected details useful for interacting with nobility, powerful merchant guilds, and the upper echelons of various levels of Imperial society — and you can recall this information perfectly. You have +2 SL on Rapport Tests when Interacting with characters you are knowledgeable about.

  • Tolerant: Surgical alteration and biological conditioning have given you a surprising tolerance for various toxins and intoxicants, making you a viable candidate to infiltrate pleasure or pestilent cults. You have Advantage on Tests to resist intoxication, various drugs, poisons, and contact with filth or pestilence that conveys disease.

  • Tainted: Prosthetics and temporary surgery allow you to disguise yourself with the tainted marks of Chaos, adorning your body in the foul symbols of the great enemy or creating prosthetic mutations of a body wracked with the corrupting influence of Chaos. You can adopt a disguise appropriately marked by Chaos to infiltrate the ranks of a cult dedicated to the Ruinous Powers.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Discipline and Rapport.

scriptData.label: Advantage to resist intoxication, drugs, poisons and disease
Interacting with characters you're knowledgeable about

notes.player: You have hardened your mind and soul against corruptive influences through psycho-conditioning and ritualistic meme-coding of liturgies and faithful hymns. Your mind and body are tempered by faith, such that encounters with malign influences only serve to inspire you to fight harder. You have Advantage on Fortitude and Discipline Tests you make to resist Corruption.

The Inquisition uses a variety of methods in their pursuit of the foes of the Imperium. Though philosophical differences lead Inquisitors and acolytes along different paths, the paths of subtlety, deception, and infiltration often allow a team to expose corruption from within. While your party’s @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.KbejcPMug5gfoWWz.JournalEntryPage.XyTxLhjDZDkpE0Lz]{Subtlety} is at Suspicious or Overt Level (7–2) or less, you can spend 1 Fate Point to count your Subtlety as Covert (10–8) for a day, solely as an individual. The GM applies positive and negative Covert Effects to you alone for the day. Note that any decreases in Subtlety you may cause are applied to the whole party’s Subtlety.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Rapport and Presence.

notes.player:
Something lies in your genetics that isn’t quite Human, twisting you physically or mentally farther away from the average Imperial citizen. Your Patron may know about your mutation, letting it slide, or be oblivious to it. On face value, you can pass unremarked. But if anyone knew the truth, they’d likely treat you as another abomination.

When you gain this Talent, roll for a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.tables.RollTable.Bb2dndjJKEPg7ubr]{Positive Mutation} and a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.tables.RollTable.Uq5u8FnAQDaoVtBt]{Negative Mutation} on the Subtle Mutations Table. Additionally, whenever you gain a Mutation or Malignancy in the future due to Corruption, you may choose to roll on the Subtle Mutations Table instead, but you must roll for both a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.tables.RollTable.Bb2dndjJKEPg7ubr]{Positive} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.tables.RollTable.Uq5u8FnAQDaoVtBt]{Negative} Mutation (roll again if you would gain a duplicate).

Rigorous training has taught you to minimise the collateral effects of manifesting psychic powers. Your psychic powers are less noticeable to bystanders or witnesses, especially those that do not understand how psychic powers work or know to attribute esoteric effects to you as a psyker. When you roll for Psychic Phenomena, roll with a −10. Additionally, when manifesting psychic powers in a way that would decrease @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.KbejcPMug5gfoWWz.JournalEntryPage.XyTxLhjDZDkpE0Lz]{Subtlety}, make a Challenging (+0) Stealth Test, succeeding means you prevent any loss of Subtlety Rating from your actions.

requirement.value: Willpower 40, the Psyker Talent, and 3 Advances in Psychic Powers.

notes.player: Whether through the Emperor’s favour, vagaries of chance or something else entirely, the destinies of the Familiar and its Master are linked. As long as it remains within line of sight of its Master, the Familiar may Spend or Burn its Master’s Fate Points.

A combination of mental conditioning, undying loyalty to the God-Emperor, and hard-won experience has left you suspicious and hardened against the threats of xenos and Chaos. Duplicity and corruption are second nature to such forces, and you are honed to expect and watch for such betrayal. You have +1 SL on Awareness and Intuition Tests against xenos and Chaos-aligned creatures, such as cultists, mutants, and daemons.

requirement.value: 2 Advances in both Awareness and Intuition.

notes.player:
Through extensive study and memorisation, you know the Lex Imperialis, the labyrinthine codes of law upon which the Imperium runs.

This Talent can be taken multiple times. Each time, choose one of the following:

  • Imperial Law: You have +2 SL on Lore Tests to recall law and law processes.

  • Judgement: You have +2 SL on Presence (Interrogation) or Presence (Intimidation) Tests to interrogate or intimidate an individual who might fear the consequences of Imperial Law.

  • Enforcer: You gain +2 SL on Rapport Tests to work with, or gain the help of, enforcers, Vigilites, or Adeptus Arbites.

scriptData.label: Gain the help of enforcer, Vigilites, or Arbites

notes.player:
Most Beasts have evolved their own set of natural tools to fulfil the role of a natural predator or allow natural prey some protection. These could be sharp claws, teeth, beaks or spined tails. In others, this aspect may present as a naturally borne viciousness or the use of a tool. The Familiar gains the following attack:

  • Improved Unarmed: Melee (Brawling), 2 + StrB + SL Damage.

This Talent can be purchased an additional time to add a Trait to the Attack. Choose from @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#defensive]{Defensive}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#reach]{Reach}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#rend-(rating)]{Rend }(1), @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#subtle]{Subtle}, or @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#thrown-(range)]{Thrown }(Short), so long as it makes sense for the type of Familiar being created.

requirement.value: Can only be purchased at Familiar Creation.

notes.player: You know how to arrange secret meetings or convey requests in coded messages and passphrases. Taking this careful approach, you can requisition aid and interact with various Factions secretly and without drawing attention. The first time you would contribute to the loss of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.KbejcPMug5gfoWWz.JournalEntryPage.XyTxLhjDZDkpE0Lz]{Subtlety} Rating in a mission, this loss does not occur.

You have developed an implacable, unwavering will in the face of adversity. Whether derived from a zealous attribution of faith, battle-worn experiences, or a product of surviving the dismal conditions of the lower hives, you know how to draw on and focus that willpower. As a Free Action, you can spend 1 Fate Point to enter a focused state of unwavering Willpower. For the rest of the encounter, your Willpower Bonus is doubled.

scriptData.label: Spend Fate to double Willpower bonus

notes.player:
You are trained in adopting disguises and creating personas. You have Advantage on any Test to apply a Disguise Kit and adopt a new identity or persona.

This Talent can be taken multiple times. Each time after the first, choose one of the following:

  • Fall Guy: You can choose to ‘burn’ a disguise or identity, sacrificing their persona by implicating them to reduce the loss of @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.KbejcPMug5gfoWWz.JournalEntryPage.XyTxLhjDZDkpE0Lz]{Subtlety} by 1 Rating. This does not immediately end suspicion, as the former identity is implicated, and enemies and targets may still be alerted.

  • Unmasked: As a Reaction before combat begins, you can dramatically unmask or reveal yourself, using pure surprise or revealing yourself as an agent of the Inquisition, to gain @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.YEIzXenjBxa3GlTQ#surprise]{Surprise}.

requirement.value: 1 Advance in Stealth (Disguise) or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand))
requirement.script: return this.actor.itemTypes["specialisation"].find(i => i.name == "Disguise" && i.system.skill == "stealth")?.system?.advances >= 1 || this.actor.itemTypes["specialisation"].find(i => i.name == "Sleight of Hand" && i.system.skill == "dexterity")?.system?.advances >= 1

notes.player: In preparation for missions, during downtime, and even during brief periods of quiet, you have trained your mind to create elaborate patterns of deception. You can create flowcharts of cover stories and articulated, modular lies to function with those cover stories based on preprogrammed scenarios and situations. When you make a Deception Test, you can spend 1 Fate Point to use Intelligence as the Characteristic, instead of Fellowship.

Some Familiars possess a venomous bite, can spin webs, or even spray incendiary chemicals. Cyber-Familiars may be upgraded with similar abilities, claws lined with toxin injectors, or ranged weapons equipped with specialised ammunition. If purchased for a Cyber-Familiar, this Talent counts towards its augmetic limits. It may be purchased for each different attack a Familiar has. If purchased twice for the same attack, the Master must choose which effect to use before their next mission and may change the effect during rest or downtime. The possible effects are:

  • Galvanic: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#inflict-(condition)]{Inflict }(@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned})

  • Venomous: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#inflict-(condition)]{Inflict }(@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#poisoned]{Poison})

  • Thermal: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#inflict-(condition)]{Inflict }(@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#ablaze]{Ablaze})

  • Exsanguinating: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#inflict-(condition)]{Inflict }(@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding})

  • Webbing: @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#inflict-(condition)]{Inflict }(@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#restrained]{Restrained})

requirement.value: Must be taken during Familiar Creation or costs an additional 500 Solars for Cyber-Familiars

notes.player: A Psyker can cast their perception into their Psyber-Familiar, gaining access to all its senses. They can see through the Familiar’s eyes or optics, hear what they hear, and so on. This is a Free Action and can be maintained as long as desired, but while borrowing their Familiar’s senses, it is difficult to remain aware of their immediate surroundings; all Awareness or Reflexes Tests suffer a −20 penalty until the Psyker returns to their own senses. Senses the Psyker lacks, such as sight beyond the visible spectrum or sounds outside the Human hearing range, are difficult to process and understand; Awareness Tests where such non-Human senses are relevant take a −20 penalty.

Monodominant and Thorian Inquisitors often use their overbearing authority to force elements of the Imperium into aiding them. When leveraging your authority, you can choose to decrease your @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.KbejcPMug5gfoWWz.JournalEntryPage.XyTxLhjDZDkpE0Lz]{Subtlety} Rating by 1 to gain Advantage on a Presence (Interrogation) or Presence (Intimidation) Test. You can also choose to decrease your Subtlety Rating by 1 to gain +3 SL on any Rapport Test that uses Influence.
